description: Get an employee's timesheet report showing target hours, actual hours logged, and variance. Can look up by employee name or default to the requesting user.

employee_name.description: Name of the employee to look up, exactly as the user wrote it and in the script they wrote it (first and last name together are fine, in either order; an e-mail address works too). Do not translate or transliterate it, and leave out any Hebrew prefix letter stuck to it (ל, ב, ה, ש, ו, מ, כ). Leave empty or say 'me' for your own timesheet.

name: get_employee_timesheet
title: Get employee timesheet
